content.title: Nvidia vs. Everybody Else: Competition Mounts Against the Top AI Chip Company
content.summary: Armed with the most advanced blueprints for graphics processing units, or GPUs, and helped by the rapid pace of innovation at  Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing  the contract fabricator that makes 90% of the world’s advanced AI chips, Nvidia has become synonymous with AI processors.  New entrants to the AI chip-design business, including Google and  Amazon  are talking about selling their most advanced chips, which rival Nvidia’s GPUs in power and efficiency, to an array of outside customers.  Smaller rivals like Advanced Micro Devices, Qualcomm and  Broadcom  are introducing products that help them focus more intently on AI data-center computing.
